scope: Portable public agent-authored escape fixture, Windows CoreCLR headless replay and fresh-process checkpoint continuation

qualification.engine: Cached compatible native engine; no full host rebuild for this check

checks: Recorded controller route rejects the locked exit, collects all three keys and completes the game.
Compiled Pause/Resume/Save/Load restores tick, key handles and exact player matrix, then completes again.
A separate native process loads the durable checkpoint and completes the game again.
limits: One fixed input route and primitive world; not broad autonomous development or a performance benchmark.
Logical HUD and headless simulation only; rendered presentation and physical input remain unqualified.
Linux and Native AOT execution of this fixture remain unqualified.
New compile-service and UI-discovery source changes are not present in the cached engine used here.
Raw RPC reports and machine-local paths remain in ignored build output.
